item.coloph: kho bo rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal lam/ o rgyan bde chen gling pa bdag gis ma sring mkha' 'gros lung bzhin kong yul dga' ba'i tshal gyi dbus phyogs yongs rdzogs dpal gyi phug nas spyan drangs ste (te)/ slar rnga chen zhes pa chu khyi'i mchu zla'i dbang phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes bzang por thar bde gsal gnas su shog ser bod yig tu 'bri bar byas/ yi ge pa ni gyer dpung (spungs) dgyes pa'i 'phang pa tril sho rir lang tsho can gyis byas pa dge'o//
